title: Migrate validate plugin to contract v2
goal: Adopt the ADR-054/ADR-055 v2 stage contract in plugins/agent/validate: v2 result file shape, disposition on every exit path, rc ∈ {0,1}, name-matched inputs via ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS, and result_contract:2 in the manifest — with tests written first.

steps.description: Write failing v2-contract tests before touching any implementation. Add SPEC-14 (every exit path emits result_contract:2 + verdict + disposition + reason), SPEC-15 (each valid_verdict driven by a test case), SPEC-16 (grep assert: no path construction in plugin.sh), SPEC-17 (fail-closed rc propagation preserved under v2), SPEC-18 (ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS is read for the deploy_result path). Update existing SPEC-9/11/12 fixtures to export a minimal ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS index JSON so they still resolve the input correctly. Confirm each new spec FAILS before any implementation change.

Add `result_contract: 2` to the `provides:` block in the manifest. No other manifest fields need changing: valid_verdicts, role, events, primary output, and name-matched inputs (id+required only, no path/from) are already correct.

Rewrite _validate_agent_run_inner to the v2 contract: (1) resolve the deploy_result input path from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS (jq .inputs.deploy_result) instead of constructing $artifacts_dir/deploy-result.json; (2) resolve the validate_result output path from ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR instead of $artifacts_dir; (3) add a helper _validate_write_result <artifacts_dir> <verdict> <disposition> <reason> that writes {result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason, data:{}} via atomic_write; (4) replace all printf/jq result writes with _validate_write_result calls using correct disposition words (missing input or missing plugin → broken; healthy probe → complete; failed probe → complete; dry-run → complete); (5) change every `return 2` to `return 1`; (6) guard validate_agent_run to emit a v2 error result when state_file is absent. Preserve the existing fail-closed rc-propagation logic for probe failures (#757). The cleanup comment at line 118 stays (no hook body — absent means nothing to free).

Run npm test (or the targeted test file) to confirm all specs including the new v2 specs go green. Also run bash scripts/lib/lint-disposition-words.sh to confirm every disposition literal is a valid member of the engine's set.

notes: Router budgets (issue mentions #1816): validate makes no LLM calls ('No LLM calls (no route_to_model)' in manifest description). The router: section and max_turns/timeout_s fields are inapplicable; plan omits them. If the acceptance reader disagrees, a one-line `router: {}` stub under config: suffices. --- cleanup hook: manifest already declares only `run`; validate holds no live resources, so the hook is correctly absent (issue: 'if it has nothing to free, the hook is absent and that is recorded, not implied'). The description already documents this; no additional manifest change needed. --- primary: true output: already declared on validate_result in the existing manifest — the issue's checkbox is already satisfied; plan notes this explicitly. --- Template wiring: validate already appears in config/templates/deployed.yaml flow: (line 31); no template file change is needed. The issue's 'wired into the live path' criterion is met by the existing entry. --- Golden diff: SPEC-9 (dry-run) and SPEC-11 (healthy probe) together constitute the before/after behavioral baseline for a passing run; no separate golden fixture file is required. --- ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS fixture in tests: tests will write a minimal JSON index ({inputs:{deploy_result:<path>}}) to a temp file and export its path as ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS before calling _validate_agent_run_inner. --- Disposition mappings: missing required input or missing plugin binary → broken (engine-promised contract violated); probe ran and returned a verdict (healthy or error) → complete; dry-run → complete. These are the only exit paths.
